latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-werewolf-openapi-skill.
- Generate dramatic werewolf transformation videos from a person photo.
- Requires HTTPS access to openapi.weshop.ai and API key (WESHOP_API_KEY) for authentication.
- Supports custom transformation descriptions, Kling model selection, video duration, audio generation, and batch video creation.
- Provides endpoints to start, poll, and manage video transformation runs.
